scientific_integrity: Earlier diagonal-resolvent and Runge--Kutta positivity criteria are credited as prior art. No independence, exhaustive literature uniqueness, or external verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted combinatorial Laplacian only; complete bipartite graphs with at least three vertices; end-step positivity only. The related Bonnans--Tan 2011 full text was inaccessible and unindexed equivalent results remain a literature-priority risk. A self-contained analytic argument proves the claimed all-parameter result; finite exact checks are corroboration, not proof.
title: Sharp positivity horizons for the theta-method on complete bipartite heat networks
